pull_request.title: feat(contracts): add coordinate-bound Vault readers and conflict classification
pull_request.body:
## Linked Issue

Refs #2116

<!-- Choose exactly one primary line: Refs #1234 keeps unfinished issue work open; Closes #1234 is for the child issue fully accepted by this PR. Keep ordinary explanations and related issues as Markdown links; use Closes only when the complete issue is accepted. -->

## Scope Summary

- Add twelve closed conflict classifications with original current-plan/coordinate binding and fail-closed authority diagnostics.
- Add actual V1 scalar metadata and source-byte readers, bounded structural path analysis, and a private root-relative Linux scope created by the existing native verifier. Preserve original plan/writer authority.
- Compute raw-byte paragraph hunks through the actual public FsusUI parser and independently recompute candidate provenance. Frontend computation has no current-plan admission transport; unsupported syntax remains refused.
- Keep taxonomy/property mappings, Windows/macOS/native qualification, remaining source syntax and current candidate transport explicitly incomplete. Retain exact supplied lock/compiler/governance prerequisite increments and the separately published architecture document.

## Change Classification

- [x] Behavior change
- [ ] Format-only
- [ ] Naming-only
- [x] Generated output
- [x] Public contract change
- [x] External naming exception
- Contract impact: compatible

`Behavior change`, `Format-only`, and `Naming-only` are mutually exclusive. `Generated output`, `Public contract change`, and `External naming exception` are supplementary.

The gate reads fields only from their named section, rejects duplicate fields or headings hidden in fenced examples, and requires contract checkboxes to be checked. Record a not-applicable reason in `Notes For Reviewers` before checking that review item.

## Tests Run

- [ ] `./tools/test.sh fast`
- [x] Targeted backend tests: original locked Release project with official SDK 10.0.302 at `c0c32cb168fbe59125b942b5964edd7263247338`: 266/266 passed, zero skips. Includes Path38, Scalar16, SourceAdmission4, Conflict44, Manifest30, Planner11, Execution33, DocumentExport70, AccountSubjectHashProjection18 and persistence2.
- [x] Targeted backend persistence: original ArticleVaultExecutionPostgresIntegrationTests ran against real disposable PostgreSQL18: 2/2 passed, zero skips; container cleaned.
- [x] Other: original source/schema/scanner controls26/26, actual public FsusUI runtime paragraph controls16/16, new9-file C# style, authoritative docs and original plus supplementary local-source typecheck passed at the same head. Live PR contract passes. Original Linux package category20 tests:3 passed/17 failed/0 skipped;16 fail with unsupported filesystem,1 with denied mount namespace. No native qualification claimed.
- [x] Negative results retained: current matrix rejects4 finite authority projections; convergence rejects2 retirement declarations. Whole C# style fails in supplied compiler/broker owner files; original frontend style cannot resolve published FsusUI module in default Project Service (locked published npm install returned401; documented source mode and real runtime work). API docs original lint retains26 reproduced baseline diagnostics. These are genuine unresolved gates; full fast and product/platform acceptance are not passed.

## External Naming Exception

For a checked `External naming exception`, point to one changed repository-relative JSON manifest using `fsusblog.external-naming-exceptions.v1`. Each entry binds one registered exception ID to its own changed paths and substantive reason; the union must exactly cover every changed registered naming surface. A missing manifest already named by an authoritative merged PR may instead use `fsusblog.post-merge-external-naming-evidence-repair.v1`; that strict repair binds immutable merge history, unchanged source blob/revision identity, the registered surface, and the exact missing artifact without changing the source again. Use `none` otherwise.

- Exceptions manifest: artifacts/change-contract/article-vault-conflict-contract-external-naming.json

- Claim level: none
- Evidence path: none
- Non-goals: No measured performance, prototype or runtime qualification.

## Release Note

The matching `release-note:*` label selects the generated release category. GitHub renders the merged PR title as the release entry, so every included category requires `Summary` to exactly equal the summary portion of the PR title after `type(scope):`; `Category: none` instead requires `Summary: none`. Pure formatting, internal renames, and CI rearrangement must use `Internal/Tooling` or `none`.

- Audience: internal
- Category: Internal/Tooling
- Summary: add coordinate-bound Vault readers and conflict classification

## Generated Output

For a checked `Generated output`, bind the output to its source through one repository-relative `.json` manifest path changed by this PR. Normal atomic source/output changes use `fsusblog.generated-output-binding.v1`. A generated-only repair for a source omission already merged into the PR base uses `fsusblog.post-merge-generated-output-repair.v1`; it must name one trusted producer and leave its source and generator unchanged. A trusted ordered multi-producer repair uses `fsusblog.post-merge-generated-output-repair-dag.v2` and its registry-owned canonical manifest path. An authenticated bot must identify itself exactly. Use `none` otherwise.

- Generator source: tests/matrix.yml
- Generated outputs: docs/testing.generated.md, config/testing/correctness-attempt-producers.json
- Digest/evidence: artifacts/change-contract/article-vault-conflict-contract-generated-binding.json
- Automation identity: none

## Rollout / Rollback

- Rollout: Draft source review only; current acceptance and authority gates remain blocked. No deployment.
- Rollback: Revert the owned reader/conflict source and registration increments; preserve the original sync-plan/writer authority.
- Deferred work: Remaining syntax/current-source transport, portable typed taxonomy/property mapping, operation-bound Git/native readers and canonical finite matrix/inventory projection from their owners, followed by original complete acceptance.
- Known limitations: Source-only classification binding is not automatic eligibility. Full fast and product/platform qualification are not passed. Applicable exact-SHA local evidence may replace remote CI; independent source review remains mandatory. All linked issues remain open.

## Notes For Reviewers

Related to [#3582](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/3582) and [#1871](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/1871). Separate architecture draft: [PR #3880](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/pull/3880).

Prerequisites were consumed only from supplied fixed increments: lock `b104b99d84b91af577336efd6430d492c25683c9` (PR #3848); compiler `a95de1defd39a46f34992bed9eee3c150d990456`, `e724251e44222c1c36388984f71f88e901a02c48`, `fd08fde79cb98cd3b4dc7fc5c8af2b09045a3733` (PR #3828); broker `9bf3ebb9779de226c369d1d0b8021ba140d2f176` (PR #3841); governance `f7b29774ae4aebad286539cc033aa736b9dbe613`, `86841bac2fb0cdbeb8baa02b218869529abbf093`, `eeb4e84096571ecb3a989629825f2508e2de7b71`, `e38a0badac3867560b5d0fdc1b8d1c648d15ee37` (PR #3859). These are not independent policy-promotion or merge receipts.

UI, migration and AEDS wire changes are not applicable. Public conflict JSON is separately versioned and embedded in the existing Shared owner. Docs were updated at maintained authoritative locations; source changes are not format-only, so formatter idempotence/blame-ignore are not applicable. No automatic eligibility, second planner/writer, fabricated native capability, manual generated output or issue closure is claimed. This draft is not an early merge candidate while required policy/source gates and actual reader functionality remain incomplete.

Published reader increment `4a30f0d3b0f397283fc0b2851d1691c44a9dacec` and native category-routing increment `c0c32cb168fbe59125b942b5964edd7263247338` cover bounded work Related to [#2109](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2109), [#2117](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2117) and [#2118](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2118). Full issue acceptance remains incomplete. The scalar reader denies opaque taxonomy/property changes; it requires portable stable identity/schema mappings from the canonical package owner. The paragraph reader preserves actual source bytes and rechecks candidate provenance but has no production current-coordinate transport and refuses unsupported syntax. Structural path classification explicitly requires native admission; the Linux scope uses the existing private root verifier, no second trust authority.

Latest fetched origin/master is `0a755584aa256995fd9997ca974806e8a0e29d2e`; the non-mutating `git merge-tree --write-tree` check exits0. These unrelated master changes were inspected and not integrated into the frozen candidate. Remote head equals the tested SHA. Independent source review remains required; this draft is not ready for merge while genuine policy/source gates and full reader/product/native capability remain incomplete. PR3879/3891 review heads are untouched.
